name: Lemony Mushroom & Orzo Soup with Tuna-Tomato Sourdough Toast

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
3 tomatoes
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms, onion, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender, 10-12 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain tuna, place in the reserved bowl, and flake with a fork. Add mayo and spices, then stir to combine the tuna salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp dill, dried
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds and set aside.

When the mushrooms are tender, zest and juice lemons into the pot, then add broth and orzo. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and cook until the pasta is tender, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2839 ml chicken or vegetable broth
170 g orzo pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Arrange bread slices on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide tuna salad between toasted bread and top with tomato slices. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with tuna-tomato toast on the side. Enjoy!
